title: Design 2: which word does the engine choose for the same behaviour
description: Behaviour sentence with she/he; choice question between the neutral and the loaded word, option order counterbalanced on half the items. Measures the language mechanism directly (models drafting or summarising evaluations).

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Design 2 measures which word the engine chooses

Scenario: A counterbalanced choice question isolates the language mechanism
  Given a behaviour sentence with she/he and a choice between the neutral and the loaded word, with option order counterbalanced on half the items
  When I run bd score on the word-choice task for the committed engine record
  Then studies/gendered-language-design2 reports the loaded-word choice rate by gender with a 95% interval, controlling for option-order bias

right_now_summary: Design 2 measures which word the engine chooses in gendered behavior descriptions.
